races.name: Bet 30 Get 5 Weekly betstgeorge.com Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners_data.note: The likely winner if this becomes a true test of stamina but needs others to ensure a proper gallop is maintained.

runners_data.name: Broomfield Aderra
runners_data.note: Will have the tactical advantage of controlling the pace but must prove capable of lasting home when challenged by fresher finishers.

runners_data.name: Willshebe Court
runners_data.note: The going concern is significant given the hold-up style that requires strong acceleration on ground that may not suit.

races.paceDynamic: Broomfield Aderra will be the only horse showing early speed with Ka Mate Du Brivet and Willshebe Court both held up in rear. This creates a false pace scenario where Broomfield Aderra can dictate terms unchallenged before the field converges late, turning this into a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Broomfield Aderra gets an easy lead and stays strong
scenarios.body: Broomfield Aderra controls the gallop completely and has enough left to resist late challenges. The hold-up horses find the sprint finish comes too late after the steady early gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet produces a strong late kick
scenarios.body: The pace collapses into a genuine sprint where Ka Mate Du Brivet's stamina and finishing power prove decisive. Broomfield Aderra pays for making the running when the field quickens significantly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Going Affects Outcome
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground plays against Willshebe Court significantly
scenarios.body: Willshebe Court struggles on the faster surface while the other two fight out the finish. Ka Mate Du Brivet and Broomfield Aderra have the race between them with the former's stamina edge telling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If all three horses struggle with the tactical nature
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where none of the hold-up horses can produce their kick effectively. Willshebe Court finds a gear despite the going concerns in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Broomfield Aderra goes too slowly early as this completely plays into Ka Mate Du Brivet's hands for the sprint finish.
Watch Willshebe Court's action on this good ground as any signs of struggling could eliminate the main pace angle threat.
Watch the pace through the middle section as any increase there will determine whether the hold-up horses get their ideal setup.
Watch for how far back Ka Mate Du Brivet drops as being too far behind in a small field sprint could prove costly.

runners_data.name: Godot

runners_data.name: Peking Opera
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed to track Motazzen and strike when the pace lifts.

runners_data.name: Wot You Wearing

runners_data.name: Vendant

runners_data.name: Kylenoe Dancer

races.paceDynamic: Motazzen as the sole confirmed front runner will dictate proceedings without early pressure, setting a sustainable gallop over this stamina test. With Peking Opera and Vendant likely to track in behind, the large contingent of hold-up horses (Geordies Betty, Godot, Wot You Wearing, Kylenoe Dancer) will create a cavalry charge from off the pace in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Motazzen Wire-to-Wire Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen gets uncontested early fractions and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader builds a decisive advantage turning for home while the hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late. Motazzen's stamina proves superior over this extended trip as the closers flatten out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Horse Godot Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes strong enough to set up the hold-up horses perfectly
scenarios.body: Godot's superior OR=102 rating tells as he produces the strongest finish from the pack of closers. The higher-rated horse gets the perfect setup from Motazzen's honest gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Peking Opera Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera gets the perfect tracking position behind Motazzen throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent runner strikes at the ideal moment, having conserved energy in the slipstream before quickening decisively. Peking Opera's tactical speed proves decisive over the staying trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites all disappoint due to ground or jumping errors
scenarios.body: The race falls apart for the market leaders, allowing a lesser-rated horse to capitalize. Kylenoe Dancer or Wot You Wearing benefit from a truly-run race that suits their underrated stamina.

watchPoints.text: Geordies Betty's going concern is critical - if struggling for action early, she's effectively eliminated from contention.
Monitor how much rope Motazzen gets in front - if building a 10+ length lead, the hold-up horses face an impossible task.
Watch Godot's position turning for home as the class horse needs room to launch his trademark late surge.
Peking Opera's jumping under pressure will determine if he can sustain a challenge when Motazzen quickens.
Track how many of the hold-up quartet get into contention together - if all four are struggling, Motazzen wins easily.

races.paceDynamic: Ronnies Reflection, Daring Plan, Valirann Gold and Engaging Sam all want prominent positions, creating a false pace scenario with no genuine front runner. This prominent congestion will set up a sprint finish favoring the three hold-up horses Kitsilano, Royal Juniper and Tom Desjy, with significant traffic problems likely at the business end when four horses converge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent quartet gets first run and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The early pace will be steady rather than strong, allowing a prominent runner to have enough left. Ronnies Reflection or Valirann Gold can capitalize on their higher ratings if getting first jump on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sweeps Through
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses neutralize each other in a messy finish
scenarios.body: Kitsilano and Royal Juniper get clean runs from the back as the four prominent runners get in each other's way. The class horse Kitsilano has the highest rating to exploit the setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Going Stops Tom Desjy
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground proves too fast for the field
scenarios.body: Tom Desjy's going concern becomes decisive as others handle the conditions better. Royal Juniper emerges as the best hold-up option with Ronnies Reflection finding extra pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Shock
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or mistakes create carnage in the straight
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely and an outsider like Engaging Sam or Daring Plan survives the chaos. Form goes out the window in a war of attrition that favors the survivors.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems 2 furlongs out when Ronnies Reflection, Daring Plan, Valirann Gold and Engaging Sam all converge from prominent positions
Monitor Tom Desjy's jumping early as any mistakes will end his chances given his need to make up ground
Look for Kitsilano to be held up longer than usual to exploit the expected pace collapse
Check if any of the prominent quartet can establish a clear lead early as this would change the entire race dynamic
Watch Royal Juniper's position turning for home as he needs to avoid the prominent traffic jam

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner among 9 runners, Unknown Entity and Graeme The Grey will likely set a tentative early gallop but neither are natural pace-setters. This creates a slowly-run affair where the pace will build gradually, setting up a sprint finish from 3f out that heavily favors the hold-up horses like The Quant, Khalk'eau Spigao and Trooper.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Unknown Entity and Graeme The Grey set a pedestrian early pace with no pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 3f sprint where hold-up horses get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks. The Quant and Khalk'eau Spigao benefit most from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: False Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the tentative leaders go too slowly and get swallowed up before the home turn
scenarios.body: Prominent racers like Jambon and Last Round find themselves in front earlier than planned and must sustain their effort. This suits horses who can travel prominently and maintain their position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Grizzled Squirrel or Unknown Entity inject pace from halfway to prevent a crawl
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates a more honest test of stamina. This scenario favors the more proven performers who can handle the pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Deteriorates
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground becomes testing and affects the hold-up horses' finishing kicks
scenarios.body: The slower surface blunts the turn of foot from back-markers and brings stamina into play. Prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems gain advantage.

watchPoints.text: I'm Wide Awake struggles to handle the good ground conditions which don't suit his preferred softer surface
Unknown Entity and Graeme The Grey set such a slow pace that the race becomes a 2f dash favoring pure speed
The Quant and Khalk'eau Spigao get shuffled back too far in the small field and cannot make up the ground
Trooper gets brought too wide around the home turn by his inexperienced jockey and loses vital momentum
Grizzled Squirrel takes up the running earlier than planned if the pace becomes too pedestrian

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey gets soft fractions and jumps cleanly throughout

Mon Champion or Koenigsstern getting too keen and applying premature pressure that could compromise their own chances
How quickly Alien Storm can get into contention from his hold-up position when the pace lifts
The jumping of all runners as any significant mistake will end chances in a competitive handicap

races.paceDynamic: Juggernaut and Test The Market are the only natural pace-setters but both prefer to track rather than truly lead, creating a dangerous pace scenario. With six hold-up horses behind them, expect a crawling early pace that will turn into a cavalry charge from the back straight, heavily favoring the strongest finishers who can position closest to the early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If neither Juggernaut nor Test The Market want the early lead and go steadily
scenarios.body: The pace collapses to walking speed early, creating a 3-furlong dash where only horses with tactical speed can win. Test The Market and Hello Cello benefit most from being closer to the crawling pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Juggernaut Sets Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Juggernaut takes responsibility and sets a genuine tempo from the front
scenarios.body: The race develops more conventionally with Juggernaut making it a true test of stamina over the trip. This plays into the hands of the better stayers who can track the pace and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Test Market Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Test The Market takes over early and dictates a moderate but even pace
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner uses tactical awareness to control proceedings and kick clear when it matters. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground in time from too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both pace horses refuse the lead and the field bunches into a crawling mess
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with horses finishing in a blanket finish after walking for most of the trip. Any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of official rating.

watchPoints.text: Juggernaut and Test The Market both refusing early responsibility could create a dangerously slow pace that ruins the race as a contest
Hello Cello and Dr Waksman getting too far back if the pace is moderate, as they'll need to be handy to have winning chances
Jacquetta and Mistress Fox for signs of handling the Good going, as both have shown preference for softer conditions
The jumping quality throughout the field as any mistake in a slowly-run race could prove decisive
Test The Market for taking control early rather than waiting, as his class advantage could be negated by a sprint finish
